_comment: Schema reference for the 'jobs' Firestore collection. NOT a live Firestore document. Use as the canonical field-name reference for all phases.
_phase4_compatibility: Existing Phase 1-3 documents may omit Phase 4 fields. Stage 2 backlog bootstrap must first discover legacy jobs with status==pending_offer without ordering by a new Phase 4 field, because ordered queries omit documents missing that field; it then transactionally materializes only safe workflow defaults. Malformed financial, assignment, or dispatch state fails closed. No destructive migration or reinterpretation of historical financial values is required.

customerMarkerPrecedence.resolutionOwner: Phase 4 customer-cancellation resolver; customer full commission credit semantics remain authoritative

raceOrders.customerMarkerFirst: driver cancellation loses and returns customer_cancellation_in_progress without penalty or domain mutation; customer resolver completes customer cancellation
raceOrders.driverCancellationFirst: driver policy commits and job returns to pending_offer; later customer cancellation reads the new current state and follows the approved customer-cancellation path

jobChanges.forfeitedAmount: overwritten with the forfeiturePaise for that most recent cancellation occurrence (non-authoritative display projection; not cumulative; wallet_entries is sole financial authority)
jobChanges.dispatchNextActionAt: set to transaction server time for immediate same-generation continuation

jobPreserved: customer cancellation/refund fields under the complete customer-marker guard
driverChanges: monthly cancellation/strict-mode/ban fields change only according to the snapshotted financial policy
dispatchRunChanges: driver remains attempted and becomes/stays excluded
_accepted_driver_cancellation_atomic_con.financialAndIdempotency: The future runtime transaction also creates/reuses the deterministic driver_cancel_credit ledger entry and completes the bound processed_requests receipt atomically. Stage 1 defines but does not implement this mutation.

_no_driver_refund_contract: Only genuine finite-generation exhaustion may set status=cancelled_system, cancelledBy=system, cancellationReason=no_driver_found, cancelledAt, refundRequestId=jobId, refundState=pending, and refundNextAttemptAt while atomically creating refund_requests/{jobId}. That request durably stores provider-valid refund_no_driver_found_{jobId} and the exact canonical payment/amount hash before provider contact; every provider attempt binds the stored key to X-Refund-Idempotency. Initiation may project submitted, while a reclaimable due provider-fetch reconciler and signed refund.processed transaction race safely to absorbing confirmed; matching provider failed results move to failed_terminal; pending/unavailable fetches remain submitted without provider resubmission and mismatched identity/amount fails closed.

jobId.description: Firestore auto-generated document ID. Also the key for the corresponding invoices/{jobId}.pdf in Storage.

customerPhone.description: Customer's WhatsApp phone number in E.164 format. Used for all subsequent WhatsApp messages (payment link, invoice, status updates).

pickupCoords.description: Customer's pickup location as sent via WhatsApp location pin.

destCoords.description: Customer's destination location as sent via WhatsApp location pin.

requestedTruckType.description: Customer's requested towing category: 'flatbed' (maps to fareCalculator serviceType 'flatbed') or 'pulling' (maps to fareCalculator serviceType 'standard').

distanceKm.description: Haversine straight-line distance in km from pickup to destination. Used for tier selection and Tier 3 commission formula. NOTE: this is the haversine distance, not the routed distance — the fare estimate applies road_curvature_factor on top.

pricingTier.description: Commission/booking-fee tier returned by the trusted Phase 2 calculator and fixed when the job is created.

bookingFeePaise.description: Platform booking fee charged to the customer in integer paise. Tier-based. This is the ONLY amount the platform collects from the customer — never the full tow fare.

driverCommissionPaise.description: Amount in integer paise deducted from the driver's wallet on job acceptance. Tier-based; Tier 3 uses the formula: tier3_driver_commission_base + (per_km_overage_rate * (distanceKm - long_distance_limit_km)).

estimatedFarePaise.description: Estimated full tow fare in integer paise — informational only, never collected by the platform. Shown to customer as 'collected directly by driver'. Calculated by fareCalculator using fare_formula.

status.description: Job state machine status. Starts at awaiting_payment. State transitions are enforced inside atomic Cloud Function transactions. The 'cancelled_system' status covers the no-driver-found case after the offer cascade is exhausted.

offeredTo.description: UID of the driver currently being offered this job. Used by the atomic accept-transaction to guard against double-assignment (checks job.status == 'offered' && job.offeredTo == driverId).

assignedDriver.description: UID of the driver who accepted the job. Set atomically when the driver accepts. Null until accepted.

channel.description: How the booking was initiated. 'whatsapp' = customer self-served via WhatsApp flow. 'phone' = co-owner took the booking by phone via Admin Panel (Phase 6).

createdByAdmin.description: Reserved for the Phase 6 Admin Panel phone-booking attribution. The current Phase 3 six-argument createJobAndQuote initializes this field to null and does not receive an admin UID.
createdByAdmin.writer: Cloud Function (Phase 3 createJobAndQuote initializes null; Phase 6 must define the authenticated admin attribution write)

razorpayPaymentLinkId.description: Razorpay Payment Link ID (plink_...) returned for the booking-fee payment.

razorpayPaymentLinkUrl.description: The Razorpay short_url returned when the Payment Link is created. Stored so payment reminders and retries can resend without contacting Razorpay again.

paymentLinkProvisioningOwner.description: Random owner token fencing recoverable Razorpay Payment Link provisioning.

paymentLinkProvisioningLeaseUntil.description: Expiry of the Payment Link provisioning owner; a stale claim may be reclaimed.

razorpayPaymentId.description: Razorpay payment ID received from the Razorpay webhook on payment success. Stored for refund operations (no-driver-found case).

paymentConfirmedAt.description: Timestamp when the successful booking-fee payment was verified and persisted.

invoiceNumber.description: Sequential GST invoice number (e.g. 'TDS-0001'). Assigned via atomic Firestore transaction on business_config.invoiceNumberCounter. Null until the booking fee payment succeeds and the invoice is generated.

invoiceUrl.description: Firebase Storage URL for the generated invoice PDF. Set once the PDF is uploaded. The PDF is also sent to the customer as a WhatsApp document — this URL is for admin reference.

invoiceSentAt.description: Timestamp written only after Meta accepts the outbound WhatsApp booking-fee invoice message. This is provider acceptance, not proof of recipient delivery; retries remain at-least-once.

invoiceStoragePath.description: Exact private Firebase Storage object path invoices/{jobId}.pdf.

invoiceIssueDateIst.description: Immutable invoice issue date in YYYY-MM-DD using Asia/Kolkata.

invoiceIssuedAt.description: Instant paired with invoiceIssueDateIst and reused on recovery.

invoiceWhatsAppMediaId.description: Meta media ID returned for the private PDF upload.

invoiceWhatsAppMessageId.description: Meta message ID returned when WhatsApp accepts invoice delivery.

invoiceSendOwner.description: Owner token fencing invoice delivery recovery.

invoiceSendLeaseUntil.description: Expiry of the recoverable invoice delivery claim.

stateVersion.description: Monotonic Phase 4 state-transition fence. Existing Phase 1-3 jobs may omit it; Phase 4 must transactionally initialize a paid pending_offer job to 0 before relying on it.

dispatchGeneration.description: Current durable finite search generation. A pre-tow driver cancellation resumes this same generation and excludes that driver rather than resetting candidate history.

dispatchState.description: Internal Phase 4 workflow state. Missing/null on a paid legacy pending_offer is treated as ready and materialized transactionally. Provider failure may enter retry_wait or operational_hold but never no_driver_found.

dispatchRunId.description: Deterministic ID of the current jobs/{jobId}/dispatch_runs/{generationId} document.

dispatchLeaseOwner.description: Opaque owner token fencing the current dispatch worker. Never exposed in job_offers.

dispatchLeaseUntil.description: Reclaimable dispatch-worker lease deadline. Correctness does not depend on a particular lease duration.

dispatchNextActionAt.description: Indexed due time for dispatch retry or reconciliation. Null means no automatically due dispatch action under the current state.

dispatchLastFailure.description: Operationally visible safe failure reason. It must not contain provider response bodies, credentials, customer data, or stack traces.

currentOfferId.description: Current top-level job_offers document. It points to the offered record and remains the current assignment projection after acceptance only until that assignment resolves. Accepted-driver cancellation must clear it; history remains in job_offers.

offeredAt.description: Server timestamp when the current offer was atomically published. Valid only while status is offered; offer history remains on job_offers.

offerExpiresAt.description: When the current offer to offeredTo expires, exactly 45 seconds after offeredAt. Cleared/resolved after the current offer. Future Cloud Task delivery is only an accelerator; reconciliation remains authoritative.

acceptedAt.description: Server timestamp when the current assigned driver atomically accepted. Accepted-driver cancellation clears it before same-generation redispatch; historical acceptance remains in the offer and ledger.

inProgressAt.description: Server timestamp for authenticated assigned-driver accepted -> in_progress transition.

completedAt.description: Server timestamp for authenticated assigned-driver in_progress -> completed transition.

commissionDebitEntryId.description: Deterministic wallet_entries document ID for the current assignment's commission debit. Accepted-driver cancellation clears this current pointer after the immutable debit/credit ledger evidence is committed.

requestId.description: Legacy schema slot for a winning accept request ID. Phase 4 handlers use actor-and-operation-scoped processed_requests receipts and must not rely on this job field alone.
requestId.writer: Cloud Function ONLY if retained as an audit projection; driver supplies requestId only as callable input

cancelledBy.description: Who initiated the cancellation. 'system' = no driver found after cascade exhausted.

cancellationReason.description: Reason for cancellation. For the system no-driver/refund workflow it must equal the exact canonical value no_driver_found; arbitrary free text is not legal for that workflow.

cancellationRequestedAt.description: Timestamp when the customer requested cancellation. Used to prevent race conditions with incoming payments.

cancellationResolutionState.description: Durable Phase 4 resolution state for customer cancellation markers written while a job is offered, accepted, or in_progress. Legacy documents may omit it and are interpreted from cancellationRequestedAt plus current status.

cancellationResolvedAt.description: Timestamp after all database-owned cancellation consequences have committed. External notification completion is tracked separately in the outbox.

cancelledAt.description: Server timestamp for a terminal customer/system cancellation. Normal accepted-driver self-cancel redispatch is nonterminal and does not set this field.

refundRequestId.description: Deterministic refund_requests document ID for approved no_driver_found initiation; exactly jobId. The ADR uses refundRequestId; no competing refundOperationId field is introduced.

refundState.description: Monotonic job-level projection of the deterministic no-driver refund request. confirmed is absorbing. Worker persistence may reach submitted; authoritative provider failed status moves submitted to failed_terminal; a due reconciler with matching processed status or Stage 9 signed refund.processed handling transactionally converges both job and refund_requests/{jobId} to confirmed, including from failed_terminal if provider processing ultimately succeeds.
refundState.writer: Cloud Function ONLY (refund initiation/reconciliation transactions; Phase 3 confirmation integration)

refundNextAttemptAt.description: Indexed due time for retryable refund initiation/reconciliation work.

razorpayRefundId.description: Razorpay refund ID received from the refund.processed webhook.

refundConfirmedAt.description: Timestamp when the refund.processed webhook successfully processed.

refundedAmountPaise.description: Customer booking-fee amount confirmed refunded by Razorpay for the no-driver-found case. This field does not represent a future driver-wallet credit.
refundedAmountPaise.writer: Cloud Function (Razorpay refund.processed webhook handler — Phase 3)

forfeitedAmount.description: Non-authoritative display/legacy projection of the forfeiturePaise for the MOST RECENT accepted-driver cancellation occurrence. wallet_entries is the sole permanent financial authority. It is NOT cumulative across repeated driver acceptance occurrences, NOT used to reconstruct wallet balance, NOT used for idempotency, and NOT used to calculate future cancellation penalties. Overwritten on each accepted-driver cancellation with that occurrence's forfeiturePaise; customer and system transitions must not interpret an old value as current financial authority. Pure wallet ledger operation — no Razorpay call.

createdAt.description: When the job document was first created by createJobAndQuote.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp. Set on every Cloud Function write to the job doc.
updatedAt.writer: Cloud Function (any handler that touches this doc)
